subject: Cloud purchase sequencing & mutual action plan for AstraGrid private offer
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wallace <emma.wallace@astragrid.com>, AstraGrid Procurement <procurement@astragrid.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud purchase sequencing & mutual action plan for AstraGrid private offer

Hi Emma / AstraGrid procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great discussion about the inference needs for the telemetry pipeline. Per our conversation I'm attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that sequences the evaluation window, technical acceptance gates, procurement milestones, and the marketplace private-offer acceptance steps across AWS / GCP / Azure (we call out optional billing paths).

Key asks on our side:
- Confirm which cloud marketplace you prefer for the private offer (AWS private offers are simplest for your current infra, but we can do GCP/Azure too).
- Share SOC 2 and vendor onboarding contacts so we can pre-fill templates.
- Target PO issuance date you want us to plan against (we suggested 2028-04-14 in the MAP).

Attached: AstraGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — this is the starting cadence; happy to adjust dates.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm cloud choice and target PO date
2) We provide formal PO template & DocuSign link
3) Technical acceptance/PO signature -> Redwood issues invoice -> Marketplace acceptance (if private offer) -> billing setup

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the MAP timeline.

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0190
[Attachment: AstraGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

From: Emma Wallace <emma.wallace@astragrid.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: AstraGrid Procurement <procurement@astragrid.com>, legal@astragrid.com
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud purchase sequencing & mutual action plan for AstraGrid private offer

Hi Markus —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the MAP. A few quick items from our side:
- Can you add a column with estimated committed monthly spend by milestone? Procurement will need run-rate numbers for the finance approval.
- We need SOC 2 evidence — please attach or point to the audit package.
- Our target is to have a signed PO executed by 2028-04-14; procurement will confirm net terms (likely net-30).

I copied our procurement inbox and legal. Legal will need to review the private-offer language and confirm we can accept marketplace billing.

Thanks — I can do a sync on Tuesday afternoon if you want to walk the timeline.

—Emma
Emma Wallace
Head of Platform Engineering | AstraGrid
emma.wallace@astragrid.com

Markus / Hiro —

Skipping the external thread for a sec — procurement asked for run-rate estimates and SOC2. I've started a short checklist for our side so we can turn around:
- Attach SOC 2 summary + auditor contact (see asking items PDF).
- Produce a one-page billing path diagram for AWS private offer vs. direct invoice (helps their finance team).
- Pre-fill the PO_template_AstraGrid.docx with Redwood billing info and estimated monthly commitment tiers.
- Confirm which marketplace SKU IDs we'll expose for the private offer (Hiro, can ops provide SKU mapping by EOD Monday?).

I attached Asking_Items_SOC2.pdf with the checklist I plan to send externally. Will draft the updated MAP v2 with the run-rate column and a DocuSign link for signatures.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
[Attachment: Asking_Items_SOC2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wallace <emma.wallace@astragrid.com>
Cc: AstraGrid Procurement <procurement@astragrid.com>, legal@astragrid.com, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Cloud purchase sequencing & mutual action plan for AstraGrid private offer

Emma —

Thanks — attached is MAP v2 with the requested run-rate column and updated milestone dates. I also attached the PO template filled with Redwood's billing/legal contact information for your finance team to review.

Highlights in MAP v2:
- Eval window: 2028-04-03 -> 2028-04-10 (7 business days) with an acceptance gate defined by throughput/latency checklist (see tab: Technical Acceptance).
- Procurement/Legal review: 2028-04-05 -> 2028-04-12 (concurrent with final testing).
- Target PO issuance: 2028-04-14 (AstraGrid) -> Redwood countersign via DocuSign -> we kick off marketplace private-offer activation.
- Billing path options: 1) AWS Private Offer (Marketplace) -> AWS invoices to AstraGrid and remits to Redwood, 2) Direct invoicing via Redwood (Net-30) with marketplace fallback.

DocuSign link (draft): https://www.docusign.com/rooms/astragrid-private-offer — we'll convert the PO_template_AstraGrid.docx into an envelope once legal confirms language.

Please see inline answers to your questions from the earlier thread above. If procurement wants a short walkthrough, Grace and I can join Tuesday 3pm PT.

Best,
Markus
[Attachments: PO_template_AstraGrid.docx (Doc), AstraGrid_MAP_v2.xlsx (Spreadsheet)]

Markus —

Procurement reviewed MAP v2 and the PO template. We're aligned with the timeline and confirm the target PO issuance of 2028-04-14. A few notes:
- We will proceed with AWS private offer as the preferred billing path; please provide the SKU mapping and the private-offer payload for our cloud team.
- Net-30 is acceptable; we'll include net-30 on the PO but legal will confirm final indemnity language.
- Please send vendor onboarding form (company profile, W-9/Tax form, and SOC 2 summary).

Once we receive the DocuSign envelope and the SKU mapping we will route for signatures. Expect procurement to issue the PO the week of 2028-04-10 -> 2028-04-14 provided no material legal redlines.
